WHAT: Two curator improvements shipped in one commit:
1. Session primer content is now injected into buildExistingMemoriesContext() so curator knows what's already covered
2. MEMORY_CURATOR_ACTIVE=1 env var in claude -p subprocess prevents hooks from firing (which would trigger real curation of the test conversation)
WHERE: src/core/curator.ts (primer injection), test-curator.ts (env var usage)
HOW: The primer summary is prepended to the existing memories block with a header 'ALREADY IN SESSION PRIMER — DO NOT RE-EXTRACT'
WHY: Without this, curator re-extracted 'Zip2 mindset', identity, ADHD every session
GOTCHA: Must explicitly pass process.env.MEMORY_CURATOR_ACTIVE when spawning claude -p or hooks will fire
